newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea won closes almost flat in cautious trading.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea won closes almost flat in cautious trading.

text.p: The won closed little changed against the dollar on Thursday as traders were cautious about possible intervention by the central bank, dealers said.
The won ended at the day's opening rate of 888.30 versus Wednesday's close of 888.40. It ranged from 888.20 to 888.60.
"Traders long with dollars are expected to reduce their positions because the dollar is not likely to rise considerably in the near future," said a foreign bank dealer.
Some dealers said the central bank was believed to have bought dollars towards the morning's close, but later they said the bank bought on Wednesday in forward trading.
Dealers said the dollar was expected to test its short-term bottom on Friday while caution would remain about the Bank of Korea's possible dollar-buying intervention.
They forecast the won's base mid-rate would be set at 888.40 won on Friday, compared with 888.50 won on Thursday.
